title: Time-R1: Post-Training Large Vision Language Model for Temporal Video Grounding

task_scope.task_family: video moment retrieval / video temporal grounding
task_scope.why_in_or_out: The task explicitly localizes query-relevant temporal moments or highlights.

evidence.quote: # Abstract Temporal Video Grounding (TVG), the task of locating specific video segments based on language queries, is a core challenge in long-form video understanding.

background_setup.summary: # Introduction Understanding long-form videos has long been a core ambition in computer vision .

evidence.quote: # Introduction Understanding long-form videos has long been a core ambition in computer vision [14, 25, 9].

background_setup.summary: A critical step toward this goal is Temporal Video Grounding (TVG) , which enables models to localize video segments corresponding to natural language queries (e.g., “Find the segment where a person walks into the living room.").

evidence.quote: A critical step toward this goal is Temporal Video Grounding (TVG) [15, 66], which enables models to localize video segments corresponding to natural language queries (e.g., “Find the segment where a person walks into the living room.").

prior_work_summary.summary: Such capability is fundamental for real-world applications, including smart home assistants and video retrieval systems on online platforms .

evidence.quote: Such capability is fundamental for real-world applications, including smart home assistants [60, 16, 49] and video retrieval systems on online platforms [5, 3].

prior_work_summary.summary: Traditional TVG approaches adopt a feature-based paradigm, where pretrained models (e.g., CLIP , I3D ) extract text and video features, followed by task-specific grounding models .

evidence.quote: Traditional TVG approaches adopt a feature-based paradigm, where pretrained models (e.g., CLIP [45], I3D [6]) extract text and video features, followed by task-specific grounding models [31, 23, 30].

prior_work_limitation.summary: these methods suffer from error accumulation due to imperfect pretrained features.

evidence.quote: However, these methods suffer from error accumulation due to imperfect pretrained features.

prior_work_limitation.summary: To overcome these limitations, recent efforts have shifted toward end-to-end Large Vision- Language Models (LVLMs) , which directly process long-form videos and text queries.

evidence.quote: To overcome these limitations, recent efforts have shifted toward end-to-end Large Vision- Language Models (LVLMs) [47, 65], which directly process long-form videos and text queries.

prior_work_limitation.summary: Despite being pretrained on datasets 100× larger than domain-specific benchmarks , LVLMs (with 7B+ parameters) often underperform compared to much smaller feature-based models (e.g., 9M parameters ).

evidence.quote: Despite being pretrained on datasets 100× larger than domain-specific benchmarks [49], LVLMs (with 7B+ parameters) often underperform compared to much smaller feature-based models (e.g., 9M parameters [23]).

prior_work_limitation.summary: This raises a critical question: Why do LVLMs, despite their vast pretrained knowledge, fail to excel on TVG?

evidence.quote: This raises a critical question: Why do LVLMs, despite their vast pretrained knowledge, fail to excel on TVG?

prior_work_limitation.summary: We attribute the suboptimal performance of LVLMs to over-penalization of false negatives during supervised fine-tuning (SFT).

evidence.quote: We attribute the suboptimal performance of LVLMs to over-penalization of false negatives during supervised fine-tuning (SFT).
